title: Spec Scenario Advisory Inventory
description: Schema for test/scenarios/catalog/_advisories.yaml. Pairs the `// Tracks: <id>` comments scattered through *_test.go files with their queue metadata (severity, source, threat category, status). The Go source is the source of truth for binding; this file is the queue.

severity.description: P0 = security/spec compliance, P1 = correctness/interop, P2 = error shape/observability. Mirrors the row severity scheme.

source.description: Canonical advisory URL (NVD, GHSA, vendor disclosure).

status.description: covered = `// Tracks:` present in the Go source. tracking = queued but not yet annotated. out-of-scope = intentional exclusion.

notes.description: Freeform context for reviewers (root cause, expected mitigation, blocked-on).

out_of_scope_reason.description: Required when status == out-of-scope. Brief justification, may reference CLAUDE.md or an ADR.
